issues.title: B1 execution infra: Render 25-service quota blocks new V3 service
issues.body:
## Resolved
Render 25-service quota blocked creation of a new V3 B1 service.

Resolution used existing autoDeploy=off temporary service `srv-db11bafavr4c739pvqm0` with an infrastructure-only adapter. The adapter fetched the public repository, required exact frozen runner commit `ec26fee3e0a85598f1d6ad2d55d9b6f128461d33`, detached to that commit, required V3 static/scientific preflight PASS, then executed the frozen B1 runner once.

First adapter attempt failed before inference because the Render clone had no `origin`; the single authorized public-URL fetch repair was used. Scientific assets were unchanged.

Successful B1 inference build: `dep-db1dgltg1s2s739m72qg`.

No GitHub Actions, Google Drive, or 4B.

issues.title: B1 evidence persistence: post-build legacy start command cannot serve frozen V3 result
issues.body:
## Resolved without model re-inference
The completed B1 build emitted all 16 raw fixture outputs before the legacy start command failed.

Persisted evidence:
- semantic cache commit `441006fdf14a1f6f5efcc867c5aa5bcedd0448af`
- full raw cache commit `d0dbc876efe82c9f018180b3409af6061025d9d9`
- raw-cache integrity gate `tools/audit_s2b2b1_raw_cache.py`
- independent semantic audit `tools/audit_s2b2b1_paired_v3.py`
- audited result commit `a2f8f6da670c2a6c2544f9b90eb281a27ab88880`

Audit PASS:
- `B1_RAW_CACHE_INTEGRITY_PASS`
- `B1_SCORE_AUDIT_PASS`
- `B1_EVIDENCE_AUDIT_PASS`
- raw cache SHA-256 `909af3cee35f48c9a3d52ec932d4b2fc3a650d2301ea135fb8b811ea3d417ae3`
- semantic cache SHA-256 `842484f8bf14dc5d74c249c8b00622926b1e4e49d7c4ca6ab61609bf16cabfae`

Independent result:
- deterministic 16/16 = 1.00
- Qwen2.5-1.5B 1/16 = 0.0625
- delta +0.9375
- frozen pre-run contract explicitly required visible parameter variable names.

Sensitivity check (non-authoritative): mapping concrete domain values back to their unique visible variables raises Qwen only to 4/16 = 0.25; deterministic gap remains +0.75 > 0.20. Thus the material result is not explained by parameter-variable formatting alone.

No scientific prompt/fixture/core/scorer/model/threshold change; no model rerun.
